### Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe clearly.

### Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you would like to see.

### Non-Negotiables Checklist
- [ ] This proposal does NOT introduce personal attributes (author names, institutions, countries, nationalities).
- [ ] This proposal does NOT use accusatory language (banned words: fake, fraud, fabricated, scam, cheat, guilty).
- [ ] Every proposed signal or claim is tied to an external, verifiable source.
